evidence.summary: run(*make_inputs()) on the actual artifact inputs produced relative L2 error 0.02364 vs the float64 exact solution, below the 0.08 tolerance; output is finite with shape (16,). The Richardson-with-64-steps concern did not materialize.

rationale: Richardson iteration with step 1 has per-mode factor (1-λ); for λ=0.03125 that is 0.96875, and 0.96875^64 ≈ 0.13, potentially leaving >0.08 relative error.

scope_rationale: Contract requires relative L2 error ≤ 0.08 vs float64 exact solution on the sole in-scope input from make_inputs().
statement: run(*make_inputs()) produces output whose relative L2 error versus the float64 exact solution exceeds 0.08.
